title: Impact of SAP GUI upgrade from 750 to 760 on existing automations
key_failure_mode: Selector with aaname attribute broke after upgrading from SAP GUI 740 to 770; minor attribute change in the underlying element tree was enough to break the automation
resolution: Switching to SAP Scripting interface-based selectors (UI Automation activity group) made selectors stable across theme/version changes; teams not yet using scripting interface had to re-test all ~35 projects end to end
quote: the change is minimal but the aaname not being there still breaks the automation

title: SAP S4H Upgrade 760-770 Impact on UiPath BAPI Automation
key_failure_mode: Background BAPI calls hung indefinitely with no error after simultaneous S/4HANA backend upgrade (1610->2021) and SAP GUI upgrade (760->770); root cause traced to outdated SAP_NCo .NET connector failing to handle changed BAPI metadata
resolution: Upgrading the SAP Connector for Microsoft (NCo) from 3.0.21 to 3.0.24 resolved the hang; also required enabling Stateful Connection=True in the SAP Application Scope activity
quote: the robot just hangs at the stage where the BAPI_XMI_LOGON is triggered... we dont see any errors but the code execution doesn't move forward
